verdict.rationale: Netlify's first-party docs say users can track project performance with every deployment and understand visitor behavior, which matches both halves of the story: site performance and visitor analytics. The support rests on a single summary-level doc line, with no detail on specific metrics, dashboards or analytics features, and no hands-on or community confirmation. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the analytics metrics and dashboards, specifics on the performance-monitoring capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.
